$comment: Provenance record for the third-party browser assets vendored into this repository. scripts/check-dependency-licenses.mjs re-hashes every file listed here on each CI run and cross-checks the version and licence against docs/dependency-inventory.json, so neither a silent edit to a vendored file nor an unaudited version bump can reach main. Files are byte-identical to the published npm package and must never be hand-edited.
